stories.title: House unanimously passes Conservative MP’s bill honouring son who died by suicide
stories.summary: The Quebec MP has been championing the legislation while grieving the loss of his son who died by suicide after struggling with addiction and encounters with the justice system.

stories.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford touts stronger ties with Quebec in Montreal speech
stories.summary: The premier used the appearance to highlight the combined economic strength of Ontario and Quebec, describing the two provinces as Canada's economic drivers.

stories.title: Quebec premier aims to expand foreign representation in Scandinavia and Africa
stories.summary: As he wraps up his first international trip, Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is elaborating on his plan to increase the number of government offices abroad from 34 to 68.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens with an anemic performance in a loss to the New York Rangers on Broadway
stories.summary: A difficult three game road trip for the Montreal Canadiens facing the best teams in the Metropolitan Division. The Rangers were the easiest of the trio, but the Canadiens fell 3-1

stories.title: Mohawk teacher, 73, earns McGill’s first PhD in Indigenous Language Revitalization
stories.summary: Mary Onwá:ri Tekahawákhwen McDonald has taught the Mohawk language to thousands of students over the past decades, from elementary school all the way to university level.

stories.title: Religious symbols ban for Quebec schoolchildren? Conservatives leave door open
stories.summary: Quebec Conservative Leader Eric Duhaime is leaving the door open to supporting the PQ government's plan to extend a religious symbols ban to elementary school students.

stories.title: After 7 years in Canada, young student faces deportation
stories.summary: A young student who has spent seven years in Canada is facing deportation as her classmates and teachers push the federal government to intervene.

stories.title: One hospitalized after fire at Montreal apartment building
stories.summary: The fire began around 3:30 p.m. in Montreal's Pierrefonds-Roxboro borough, on Riviera Street at the corner of Riverdale Boulevard.

stories.title: No complaint received by ombudsman after children allegedly confined in locker
stories.summary: Quebec's ombudsman's office says it won't be able to investigate or issue recommendations until a parent or student files a complaint.

stories.title: Quebec police investigate Granby shooting that left one dead, one injured
stories.summary: A man in his 30s is dead and a woman was badly injured after what police are calling a targeted shooting in Granby, in the province's Eastern Townships.
